description: PDF with one embedded JPEG or PNG (base64; PNG without alpha channel) plus optional caption and render width/height. Inside a longer document use an 'image' block of generate_basic_pdf instead. PDF/A, print, metadata and creationDate options as on every document tool.

align.description: Horizontal placement of the image inside the content width.

alt.description: Accessible description of the image (tagged /Figure /Alt). Provide it for non-decorative images under PDF/A or PDF/UA.

caption.description: Optional caption rendered below the image.

compress.description: FlateDecode the streams (smaller file, different bytes; PDF/A unaffected, XMP stays plain). Default false.

creationDate.description: ISO-8601 instant for /CreationDate (+ XMP, the trailer /ID and the {date} placeholder), written in UTC. Pin it for byte-identical output across calls and hosts; omitted = wall clock, so every call differs.

debug.description: Draw margin / block / cell guide rectangles (unmarked content — not for PDF/UA output). Geometry unchanged. Default false.

embedFonts.description: Embed Noto Sans Latin instead of the viewer base-14 Helvetica. REQUIRED for a valid PDF/A or PDF/X claim (every font embedded) and for strict=true; adds ~0.3 MiB.

encrypt.description: Encrypt at build time (AES-128 default / AES-256) and KEEP the AcroForm — unlike encrypt_pdf, which rebuilds the page tree. Exclusive with pdfA. Randomised output, never cached.

permissions.description: Permission flags; each defaults to allowed.

userPassword.description: Open password; omitted/empty = opens without a prompt.

footerTemplate.description: Running footer on every page. Replaces the default footer: footerText is then ignored and page numbers appear only via {page}/{pages}.

center.description: Placeholders: {page} {pages} {title} {date} (UTC date of creationDate when pinned, else of the build).

anyOf.description: DeviceCMYK operands 'C M Y K', each 0.0–1.0.
DeviceCMYK ink percentages [c, m, y, k], each 0–100.

left.description: Placeholders: {page} {pages} {title} {date} (UTC date of creationDate when pinned, else of the build).

right.description: Placeholders: {page} {pages} {title} {date} (UTC date of creationDate when pinned, else of the build).

headerTemplate.description: Running header on every page (left / center / right zones); reserves 15 pt.

center.description: Placeholders: {page} {pages} {title} {date} (UTC date of creationDate when pinned, else of the build).

anyOf.description: DeviceCMYK operands 'C M Y K', each 0.0–1.0.
DeviceCMYK ink percentages [c, m, y, k], each 0–100.

left.description: Placeholders: {page} {pages} {title} {date} (UTC date of creationDate when pinned, else of the build).

right.description: Placeholders: {page} {pages} {title} {date} (UTC date of creationDate when pinned, else of the build).

height.description: Render height in points. If omitted, aspect ratio is preserved.

imageBase64.description: Base64 image bytes. JPEG (baseline; 1, 3 or 4 components — CMYK raises PDFA_DEVICE_CMYK_IMAGE under PDF/A) or PNG (8-bit greyscale/RGB, non-interlaced; alpha-channel and palette PNGs are rejected with a remedy). No data: URI.

includeDiagnostics.description: Return the diagnostics raised while building (PDFA_*, PDFX_*, TYPOGRAPHY_*) as `diagnostics[]` (possibly empty).

margins.description: Margins in points, all four required (0–200). Default 45 / 36 / 35 / 36.

metadata.description: /Info (+ XMP under PDF/A): author, subject, keywords, /Trapped.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the image. Must match the actual encoding of imageBase64 (magic bytes are checked).

outputIntent.description: Custom OutputIntent (under pdfA or pdfx): an RGB, CMYK or Gray ICC profile + condition strings, replacing the built-in sRGB intent. The profile must be a real ICC file ('acsp' signature, consistent size — PRINT_ERROR otherwise); pdfx needs device class 'prtr'. Under a CMYK / Gray intent RGB content is mapped through a calibrated default space.

iccProfileBase64.description: ICC profile bytes, base64 (RGB, CMYK or Gray; ≤ 8 MiB).

outputMode.description: Either 'base64' (returns the PDF inline) or 'file' (writes to a sandboxed path inside PDFNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR).

outputPath.description: Required when outputMode='file'. Relative path inside the sandbox; must end with .pdf.

pageSize.description: Portrait page preset (points): A4 595.28×841.89 (default), Letter 612×792, Legal 612×1008, A3 841.89×1190.55, Tabloid 792×1224. print.* boxes must fit it.

pdfA.description: PDF/A level: pdfa1b (simple text+images), pdfa2b/pdfa2u (richer; 2u = Unicode mapping), pdfa3b (attachments / Factur-X). Pair with embedFonts=true for a valid claim. Exclusive with encryption. See docs/guides/PDFA.md.

pdfx.description: PDF/X-4 print exchange (ISO 15930-7). REQUIRES outputIntent with the printer's ICC profile (device class 'prtr'; CMYK or Gray — none is bundled); needs embedFonts:true for a conformant file (PDFX_NO_FONT_ENTRIES otherwise, strict:true refuses). Exclusive with pdfA and encrypt; metadata.trapped must be 'True' or 'False'; TrimBox or ArtBox, not both. Links and form fields are reported (PDFX_ANNOTATIONS). Check with validate_pdf standard:'pdf-x-4'. See the print_ready prompt.

print.description: Print production (ISO 32000-1 §14.11): page boxes, `bleed` shorthand (TrimBox = MediaBox inset), crop/registration marks outside the TrimBox, /UserUnit for large formats (PDF 1.7; not under pdfa1b). See docs/guides/PRINT.md.

artBox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in points, origin bottom-left, inside the MediaBox.

bleed.description: Bleed in points (8.5 = 3 mm); sets TrimBox = MediaBox inset. Exclusive with trimBox.

bleedBox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in points, origin bottom-left, inside the MediaBox.

cropBox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in points, origin bottom-left, inside the MediaBox.

marks.description: Printer's marks (needs bleed or trimBox): true for defaults, or an object.

tints.description: Add the four 50 % tint patches. Default true.

colourBars.description: Colour control strip in the bleed (C M Y K solids + their 50 % tints): true for defaults. Off by default; needs a bleed of about 5 mm (14.17 pt) and is skipped when the strip would not fit.

offset.description: Gap between TrimBox and marks in points. Default 5.

trimBox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in points, origin bottom-left, inside the MediaBox.

userUnit.description: /UserUnit (multiples of 1/72 in) for pages over 14400 pt. Rejected under pdfa1b.

strict.description: Fail instead of producing a file the engine warns about: a PDFA_* diagnostic → PDF_A_COMPLIANCE_VIOLATION (e.g. PDFA_NO_FONT_ENTRIES without embedFonts), a PDFX_* one → PDF_X_COMPLIANCE_VIOLATION, any other → DIAGNOSTIC_ESCALATED. Pair with embedFonts=true.

title.description: Document title rendered at the top and used as PDF metadata title.

typography.description: Fine typography, all opt-in (omitted = unchanged bytes). kerning, fontFeatures and the 'fr' narrow space need embedFonts:true. No hyphenation dictionary is installed: use soft hyphens (U+00AD). See the typography prompt.

bindShortWords.description: Never end a line on a short word: up to maxLength letters (default 1), or exactly the listed words.

fontFeatures.description: OpenType features, later wins. tnum / lnum are no-ops on Noto Sans (TYPOGRAPHY_FEATURE_INEFFECTIVE).

hyphenationLanguage.description: BCP 47 tag; no effect here (no hyphenation provider installed).

keepHeadingsWithNext.description: Never strand a heading at a page foot. true = { minLines: 2 }.

metrics.description: Base-14 text: 'exact' uses the AFM widths (different wraps). Default 'approximate'.

opticalMargins.description: Hang punctuation into the margin of align:'justify' text.

orphans.description: Min lines left at a page foot (default 2; needs splitParagraphs).

punctuationSpacing.description: No-break spaces next to punctuation (existing spaces only). 'fr': narrow before ; ! ?, no-break before ':' and inside « ». 'fr-CA': ':' and « » only. Or explicit rules.

splitParagraphs.description: Paragraphs may break across pages at a line boundary (default: atomic).

unitBinding.description: No-break space between a number and its unit ('150 €', '12 kg'); units replaces the built-in list.

widows.description: Min lines carried over (default 2; needs splitParagraphs).

width.description: Render width in points. If omitted, the image is auto-sized to fit the page.

name: embed_image

outputSchema.description: Result of a PDF-producing tool. base64 mode: the PDF arrives as an embedded `resource` content block (not duplicated here); file mode: `filePath`.
